name: Actual Budget
description: Super-fast privacy-focused budgeting app: envelope budgeting, bank sync via plugins, multi-device sync on your own server.
compose:
services:
  actual:
    image: actualbudget/actual-server:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:5006"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
